title: Embedded In-Process Graph Database Drivers with Kùzu

claims.assertion: Providing an embedded in-process graph engine driver (Kùzu) behind standard graph operations interfaces enables zero-infrastructure local execution and rapid unit testing without external database containers

context: Requiring a running Neo4j or Memgraph instance for development, integration testing, and local CLI tools introduces high friction, slow CI pipelines, and external dependency failures.
distilled_learning: Encapsulate graph persistence behind an abstract GraphDriver interface that exposes domain operations (EntityNodeOperations, EntityEdgeOperations, SearchOperations). Implement an in-process adapter using Kùzu (an embedded C++ Cypher-compatible columnar graph database), allowing developers to run full graph queries directly within the Python process or against local files.
